deadline.value: Priority consideration is given to applications fully completed before December 15. Year 2026 is inferred for Fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: Priority will be given to applications fully completed before December 15.

gre_subject.value: ETS does not offer a GRE Subject Test in Biological Sciences.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applications are reviewed by the admissions committee, which invites promising applicants for a remote interview prior to a final decision (no pre-admission supervisor agreement is required, though naming faculty of interest in the statement of purpose is preferred).
supervisor.quote: Once applications are reviewed by the admissions committee, promising applicants will be invited for a remote interview prior to final acceptance decision.

funding.value: The Ph.D. in Complex Biological Systems page does not state fellowship or stipend funding terms.

entry_route.value: Entry requires a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) from an accredited institution, with evidence of success in life sciences coursework preferred.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor’s degree (or its equivalent) from an accredited institution of higher learning, evidence of success in life sciences-relevant coursework preferred
